Combattimer 1.0 for Minecraft 26.3, built with Java 25 against Spigot API 26.3-R0.1-SNAPSHOT.

Download `Combattimer-1.0.jar` and place it in the server's `plugins` folder. The server requires Java 25. `SHA256SUMS` contains the checksum of this exact release build.

The timer cleanup, plugin entry point and standard resource path were corrected during the compatibility update. The release workflow performs a clean Maven verification before uploading the JAR. This repository has no automated test sources; live server and multiplayer gameplay were not tested.
